events.quote: blast will go live next week, Thursday, at 7.50 a.m. UTC time.
events.note: "blast" appears to be a transcription artifact; Barnabas is referring to Gloas (the Glamsterdam CL upgrade). Thursday after Aug 13 call = ~Aug 20 2026.

events.quote: This is EIP7923. This is linear page-based memory costing, and what does it do? The current EVM prices, prices the memory allocation quadratically.
events.note: Presented by jochem-brouwer as candidate for Hegota in the PFI session; no objections raised.

events.quote: The next one is EIP23298, this is remove of refunds.
events.note: Presented by jochem-brouwer for Hegota; draganrakita suggested keeping the reset-to-original refund while removing only the storage-clearing refund, but did not object to the EIP as a candidate. No rejection of the EIP itself.

events.quote: Okay, so the payout codes, what is this? The question is, how do you currently send ethereum to an external foreign-interested account?
events.note: Presented by jochem-brouwer for Hegota; jochem offered to champion EIP-5920 if no existing champion. No objections raised.

events.quote: Yeah, this EIP basically discounts the gas used for when you have call-up code with value.
events.note: Presented by draganrakita for Hegota; no objections raised.

events.quote: this is the next one. This is about… Not reverting access lists.
events.note: Presented by draganrakita for Hegota; Danno Ferrin flagged implementation complexity concerns ('this might be bigger than it looks') but did not reject the EIP.

events.quote: It's basically a recalibration of the constant we introduced in 8037.
events.note: Presented by Toni Wahrstätter on behalf of Maria for Hegota; no objections raised.

events.quote: So, the other one, which is called, 8077.
events.note: Presented by Csaba for Hegota (as EIP-8077, announce transactions with nonce); no objections raised.

events.quote: 894 is the blobman pool. I will start with that one.
events.note: Presented by Csaba for Hegota (as EIP-8094, blob-aware mempool; '894' is speech for 8094); no objections raised.

events.quote: So I'm proposing, MLDSA precompiles, I'm proposing just the simple FIPS 204 variant of it
events.note: Presented by Danno Ferrin for Hegota; questions asked but no rejections; wide language support by Hegota ship date cited.

events.quote: the problem we are facing is that we don't know whether users will spend 50% of their gas budget on state creation of the Glamsterdam.
events.note: Presented by Anders Elowsson for Hegota as a one-time calibration EIP after Glamsterdam; no objections raised.

events.quote: So, the idea is to reduce the security impact of unusually large execution rewards. It burns protocol
events.note: Presented by Ben Adams for Hegota; lightclient raised concern about EPBS adoption uncertainty. Quote is from Ben Adams' opening description of the EIP at 1:06:54.

events.quote: basically, the most basic, DFI operation, I would argue, is, like, an addition, and if you insidity you do A plus B. As most of you are probably aware, on EVM level, you're doing something way more complicated
events.note: Presented by Hubert Ritzdorf for Hegota; Danno Ferrin raised concerns about RISC-V/WASM compatibility and whether shaving gas is still essential, but did not reject.
